text.arabic_uthmani: وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَٰفِلًا عَمَّا يَعْمَلُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ ۚ إِنَّمَا يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ لِيَوْمٍۢ تَشْخَصُ فِيهِ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ

words.gloss_range: resumptive connector opening a linked but new warning after the preceding prayer
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) crosses the boundary from petition into warning without making the new verse sound detached. It links back to the prayer and reckoning frame of 14:41, then immediately fuses with the prohibition that follows, so the ayah opens as resumed discourse that has changed register.

topics.headline: resumptive boundary into warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse is linked to the preceding prayer while shifting into direct corrective warning.
topics.reason: The conjunction connects to prior discourse, while the following prohibition confirms a new address frame rather than a continuation of the prayer voice.

topics.headline: connector fused to prohibition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the boundary marker and the prohibition as one compact opening pulse.
topics.reason: The one-letter connector attaches directly to the following negative particle, making the transition and command-force arrive together.

words.gloss_range: prohibitive negator governing an emphatic cognition verb and barring the whole false supposition
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) is not a neutral negative; before the energetic verb it functions as a prohibitive particle. Its scope reaches over the whole mental construction, so the reader is not merely told that God is not heedless but is barred from forming that reckoning at all. Because the next verb is direct second-person address, the warning pulls the listener out of the prayer frame and into confrontation.

topics.headline: maximal prohibitive force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening negation is a command against thinking, intensified by the following energetic verb.
topics.reason: The QAC grammar identifies prohibitive force with energetic morphology on the governed verb.

topics.headline: negation scopes over the whole thought
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the forbidden object is the entire interpretation of delay as divine inattention.
topics.reason: The particle governs the cognition verb and its complements, so the correction targets the whole proposition.

topics.headline: direct address break
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the discourse pull the listener directly into the warning after the prayer frame.
topics.reason: The independent negator before the second-person verb makes the address shift explicit.

words.gloss_range: emphatic second-person cognition verb: reckon, suppose, or calculate within a double-object judgment frame
words.root_gloss_range: reckoning, counting, accounting, supposing, and evaluating; locally the mental-reckoning branch is selected while the accountability field remains active
words.prose: {{ar:تَحْسَبَنَّ}} ({{tr:taḥsabanna}}) makes the first arena of the ayah the addressee's reckoning. Its double-object frame turns the forbidden act into assigning a false predicate to God, while the root's accounting range recalls the reckoning horizon of 14:41 and turns it into a warning against human miscalculation. The energetic ending tightens that prohibition; canonical vowel variation changes texture, not the local cognitive-command structure. The same energetic correction formula also answers false assumptions about divine action or inaction at 3:169 and 3:178.

topics.headline: forbidden double-object reckoning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse corrects a human act of evaluation before explaining divine action.
topics.reason: The verb is second-person and governs the divine name plus the rejected predicate, making the prohibited act a judgment frame.

topics.headline: reckoning becomes misreckoning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the root of reckoning shift from the objective day of account in 14:41 to a forbidden human calculation in 14:42.
topics.reason: The calculation and account range is locally relevant because 14:41 named the reckoning day and 14:42 prohibits a false reckoning about delay.

topics.headline: energetic form with variant texture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the surface carries maximal command pressure while accepted vowel variation leaves the meaning intact.
topics.reason: The energetic ending is local and governing; the variant evidence is retained as recitational contrast rather than a change in sense.

topics.headline: false-assumption correction formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the formula as correcting false conclusions about divine action or inaction, including parallels at 3:169 and 3:178.
topics.reason: The supplied parallels at 3:169 and 3:178 use the same energetic cognition formula to correct mistaken assumptions, while local syntax determines this verse's specific content.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as the first accusative object of the forbidden reckoning
words.root_gloss_range: deity, worship, authority, refuge, and bewilderment fields; locally concentrated in the proper name rather than distributed as separate derivative senses
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}) is the named object of the forbidden calculation. Its accusative position makes God the one about whom the false predicate would be assigned, and its placement between the verb and the heedlessness predicate makes the rejected attribution pass through the divine name. The proper-name form narrows the field away from a generic deity idea while retaining authority, worship, and refuge pressure as the background that makes heedlessness impossible to predicate. The word also sets the ayah's frame: God is named first, the wrongdoers are named as agents, and the day becomes the closing explanation.

topics.headline: named object of false reckoning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that God is the specific object about whom the prohibited judgment would be made.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence identifies the divine name as the first object of the cognition verb.

topics.headline: proper name blocks generic deity reading
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the warning concerns the known divine referent, not a generic concept of deity.
topics.reason: The proper noun form and definite identity keep the reference specific inside the prohibited proposition.

topics.headline: divine authority field concentrated in the name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels that worship, authority, and refuge pressure make the false predicate theologically weighty, while the local surface remains a proper name.
topics.reason: The derivational field is relevant as pressure behind the proper name but does not replace the local proper-name reading.

topics.headline: divine name against wrongdoers and day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the verse frame: God is named at the opening, wrongdoers are named as agents, and the day closes the explanation.
topics.reason: The collocation rows become local through the surface sequence of divine name, wrongdoers, and the endpoint day.

words.gloss_range: active participle naming the rejected predicate: heedless, inattentive, or non-monitoring
words.root_gloss_range: heedlessness, negligence, inattentive absence, and non-monitoring; locally the participial predicate is categorically denied of God
words.prose: {{ar:غَٰفِلًا}} ({{tr:ghāfilan}}) names the false state the verse forbids assigning to God. As an indefinite accusative active participle, it presents heedlessness as a predicate-quality and then excludes it in relation to the wrongdoers' ongoing deeds. The root often warns humans about heedlessness, but here the direction is inverted: the quality cannot be assigned to God. The word also sharpens the boundary from 14:41: forgiveness may cover faults by choice, but this ayah denies any absence of divine attention.

topics.headline: rejected predicate quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse rejects a specific predicate assigned to God, not merely a vague wrong thought.
topics.reason: The accusative participle completes the double-object cognition frame and is the predicate being denied.

topics.headline: denied heedlessness tied to deeds
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the denied inattention is immediately tied to what wrongdoers do, not left abstract.
topics.reason: The following governed phrase supplies the content of the denied predicate.

topics.headline: human heedlessness inverted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a quality commonly warned against in humans is here precisely what must not be assigned to God.
topics.reason: The root's broader warning field survives as inversion, while the local grammar keeps the point as a denied divine predicate.

topics.headline: forgiveness boundary contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a boundary contrast between chosen covering in 14:41 and impossible non-attention in 14:42.
topics.reason: The near-sound boundary echo from 14:41 to 14:42 is concrete and semantically useful, but it supports rather than overrides the local predicate.

words.gloss_range: contracted preposition plus particle, routing the denied heedlessness toward the following deed clause
words.prose: {{ar:عَمَّا}} ({{tr:ʿammā}}) keeps the denial from staying abstract. The fused form carries the complement of the heedlessness predicate into the following deed clause, so the scope is either what they do or their doing itself. Its contraction makes that grammatical routing compact, while the base preposition's separation image is useful only as a local pressure: the verse denies any distance between divine awareness and the deeds.

topics.headline: scope routed to deed clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied heedlessness is grammatically aimed at the wrongdoers' actual doing.
topics.reason: The particle phrase is governed by the predicate and opens the following clause as its content.

topics.headline: relative or verbal-noun parse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the syntax can cover both the individual deeds and the fact or process of their doing.
topics.reason: Both parses fit the local construction, so the topic is preserved as range rather than selecting one exclusive reading.

topics.headline: fused form denies awareness-distance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the compact surface while noticing that no separation is allowed between awareness and deeds.
topics.reason: The assimilation is directly visible, while the separation image is limited to prepositional pressure under the denied predicate.

words.gloss_range: imperfect deed verb: doing, working, operating, or producing action under observation
words.root_gloss_range: deed, work, labor, operation, and accountable action; locally the ongoing action of wrongdoers is selected
words.prose: {{ar:يَعْمَلُ}} ({{tr:yaʿmalu}}) supplies the content of the denied heedlessness. Its imperfect form keeps the wrongdoers' activity ongoing, and its object-light frame lets the phrase include both what they do and the way they operate. The verb arrives before its subject, so the deed is heard first and the agent-class lands afterward; action then becomes the material that the delay clause carries toward the endpoint day, linking deed and accountability.

topics.headline: ongoing deeds under attention
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the deeds are not sealed in the past but presented as ongoing activity under divine attention.
topics.reason: The imperfect indicative form states ongoing action inside the relative content clause.

topics.headline: doing as productive operation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the wrongdoers' conduct as a pattern of operation, not only a single named offense.
topics.reason: The broader work and operation range is valid, while local syntax keeps the selected sense as their doing within the relative clause.

topics.headline: deed before agent reveal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the activity before the wrongdoer label, making the agent-class land as the close of the first beat.
topics.reason: Verb-before-subject order is normal Arabic, but in this clause it creates a local beat where action precedes the named class.

topics.headline: deeds linked to accountability day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the ongoing deeds to the later endpoint day rather than treating them as background detail.
topics.reason: The deed root is locally upstream of the delay-to-day clause and participates in the Surah 14 accountability thread, including 14:18.

words.gloss_range: definite active-participle plural: the known wrongdoers acting as subject and later resumed by the object pronoun
words.root_gloss_range: wrongdoing, injustice, oppressive displacement, and darkness; locally the active wrongdoer class is selected while darkness pressure remains relevant
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ}} ({{tr:al-ẓālimūna}}) names the agents at the end of the first beat. The definite active participle marks a known class defined by ongoing wrongdoing, not an abstraction called injustice. It also becomes the antecedent of the later delay-verb pronoun, so the doers of the deed become the ones delayed. Surah 14 repeatedly returns to this wrongdoer thread, and 14:44 later voices the delayed group's plea for more delay; the root's injustice and darkness field prepares the verse's movement toward eyes forced open.

topics.headline: subject becomes delayed object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same wrongdoers from agents of action to objects of deferral.
topics.reason: The nominative subject is the antecedent for the later plural object suffix.

topics.headline: known active wrongdoer class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the verse names an established agent-class characterized by ongoing wrongdoing.
topics.reason: The definite active participle and plural human ending identify a known accountable group.

topics.headline: injustice with darkness pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the wrongdoer label as more than generic evil: it carries displacement and darkness pressure before the final sight image.
topics.reason: The darkness and displacement field is relevant to the label, while local syntax selects the active participle wrongdoers.

topics.headline: surah wrongdoer thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader places these wrongdoers inside Surah 14's recurring wrongdoing and delay thread, including the later plea for delay at 14:44.
topics.reason: The same-surah references are concrete and locally anchored by the wrongdoer label and the next delay verb.

words.gloss_range: restrictive particle introducing the true explanation of apparent delay
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّمَا}} ({{tr:innamā}}) pivots the ayah from forbidden thought to correct explanation. It restricts the account of apparent inaction to purposeful deferral: not heedlessness, but delay toward a described day. Its fused grammar lets the following verb clause carry the restricted proposition, and the direct transition keeps the second half as an answer to the first. The doubled n sound makes the restrictive pivot audible before the delay verb arrives.

topics.headline: restriction explains delay
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle excludes heedlessness as an explanation and replaces it with directed deferral.
topics.reason: The particle is identified as restrictive and scopes over the delay clause with its endpoint.

topics.headline: fused particle parse pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees how the fused form turns assertion-plus-particle material into a restriction device here.
topics.reason: Alternate parsing is useful as grammatical pressure, but local function and QAC evidence select restriction.

topics.headline: correction-to-explanation pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the verse move from what not to think to what is actually happening.
topics.reason: The particle begins the second major clause without a new conjunction, making it the answer to the opening prohibition.

topics.headline: geminated pivot pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the restrictive pivot as a compact pressure point before the delay verb.
topics.reason: The fused surface and doubled consonant are local features that support the particle's structural role.

words.gloss_range: Form II imperfect with object suffix: actively causing them to be deferred or put later
words.root_gloss_range: lateness, putting behind, delay, postponement, and end-state; locally the caused deferral of wrongdoers is selected
words.prose: {{ar:يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ}} ({{tr:yuʾakhkhiruhum}}) gives the positive explanation: God is actively deferring the wrongdoers. The suffix carries the agents of the deed verb into the object position, so agency becomes liability. Form II makes delay an imposed scheduling act, not passive absence, and the doubled middle radical gives that postponement audible weight. The accepted first-person plural variant shifts the stance to direct divine speech while keeping the same delayed object, and the root's end-state field anticipates the later scene where those delayed seek further delay at 14:44.

topics.headline: agents become deferred objects
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the wrongdoers from acting subjects into the object position of divine deferral.
topics.reason: The attached suffix refers back to the wrongdoers and makes them the object of the delay verb.

topics.headline: caused deferral, not neglect
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees delay as active divine scheduling rather than inactivity or neglect.
topics.reason: The imperfect Form II verb supplies the restricted action that answers the forbidden heedlessness inference.

topics.headline: variant exposes divine agency stance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a recognized variant shifts the discourse from third-person narration to direct divine speech without changing the delayed object.
topics.reason: The variant is retained as contrast in person and voice, while the local canonical surface remains third-person singular.

topics.headline: delay points to endpoint and later plea
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this imposed delay to the endpoint day and to the later plea for delay at 14:44.
topics.reason: The root field and same-surah echoes are locally anchored by the following endpoint phrase and the later 14:44 delay request.

topics.headline: weighted delay sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the doubled middle radical giving the deferral verb deliberate weight.
topics.reason: The sound feature is local to the Form II surface and supports the deliberate-delay reading.

words.gloss_range: prefixed lām marking the endpoint, goal, and temporal limit of the delay
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) prevents the delay from ending as an abstraction. It governs the following day word, making the day the destination and limit of the deferral, and its scope reaches into the clause that describes what happens there. Because the endpoint marker is prefixed directly to that day word, the surface binds the goal to the act of deferral; the small preposition is therefore the hinge from the restricted delay clause into the final staring-eyes scene.

topics.headline: delay given an endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the postponement is directed toward a goal and limit, not left indefinite.
topics.reason: The prefixed preposition governs the day noun as the endpoint of the delay verb.

topics.headline: hinge into day description
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the delay through the day noun into the sensory clause that defines it.
topics.reason: The governed noun is modified by the following relative clause, so the preposition leads into the whole day-description.

topics.headline: prefixed endpoint marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the endpoint marker bound directly to the day word, matching the tightness of the explanation.
topics.reason: The proclitic form visibly binds the endpoint to the noun and supports the goal-limit reading.

words.gloss_range: indefinite genitive day or appointed time, governed as the endpoint of delay and defined by the following clause
words.root_gloss_range: day, bounded time, appointed period, and eschatological event; locally an unnamed endpoint day defined by staring eyes
words.prose: {{ar:يَوْمٍۢ}} ({{tr:yawmin}}) is the endpoint of the delay, but it is not given a title here. Its indefiniteness lets the following clause define it by what happens inside it: eyes stare. The common time-word is thus made marked by construction: it can carry an appointed eschatological period, but the local wording withholds a title and shifts the horizon from the reckoning day named in 14:41 to a day recognized through its sensory effect.

topics.headline: unnamed day defined by event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the day is identified by the staring-eyes event rather than by a ready title.
topics.reason: The indefinite noun is modified by the following clause, with the pronoun in the next phrase looping back to it.

topics.headline: governed endpoint of deferral
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the delay aimed at a bounded endpoint where abstract scheduling becomes scene.
topics.reason: The lām governs the genitive day noun as the endpoint of the delay verb.

topics.headline: appointed eschatological time field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the eschatological day-field without losing the local fact that this occurrence is unnamed and described by an event.
topics.reason: The broader day-field is relevant, but the local form avoids a title and defines the day through the following clause.

topics.headline: reckoning day becomes sight scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the prior reckoning horizon of 14:41 re-presented here through the bodily image of staring eyes.
topics.reason: The same time root crosses the boundary, but the defining mode changes from juridical reckoning to sensory effect.

words.gloss_range: imperfect Form I verb of fixed staring, rising exposure, and visible immobility, selected for eyes
words.root_gloss_range: fixed staring, protruding or rising visibility, exposed personhood, and visible figure; locally eyes select the fixed staring sense with exposure pressure
words.prose: {{ar:تَشْخَصُ}} ({{tr:tashkhaṣu}}) turns the unnamed day into a scene. The imperfect verb makes the stare happen within the day, and the Form I surface keeps the focus on the eyes' own fixed, exposed staring rather than a causative sending-away sense. Because the root is rare and paired with eyes again at 21:97, the closing image is not generic seeing; it is an apocalyptic register of perception locked open. Its sh-kh-ṣ sound moves from hiss to throat to emphatic closure, making the fixed stare feel hardened in recitation.

topics.headline: staring event defines the day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the abstract endpoint become a vivid event inside the day.
topics.reason: The imperfect verb is the predicate of the clause modifying the day noun.

topics.headline: fixed stare with exposure pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader imagines eyes fixed and exposed, not merely ordinary looking.
topics.reason: The local subject selects the eye-staring sense while allowing the root's exposure and protrusion pressure to remain visible.

topics.headline: Form I agreement with eyes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb belongs grammatically to the eyes and is not a causative departure verb.
topics.reason: The feminine singular verb agrees with the broken plural subject and the Form I surface blocks a causative Form IV reading.

topics.headline: rare apocalyptic eye formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the verb as part of a tiny eschatological eye-staring field, with the other supplied scene at 21:97.
topics.reason: The supplied occurrence evidence gives another eye-staring eschatological use at 21:97, while local grammar keeps 14:42's imperfect construction distinct.

topics.headline: sound hardens with the stare
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the consonant sequence tighten as the word names visual fixation.
topics.reason: The phonetic observation is local to the consonants and supports the fixed-stare image without controlling the parse.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus suffix referring back to the day and locating the stare within it
words.prose: {{ar:فِيهِ}} ({{tr:fīhi}}) loops back to the day word, making the final clause a description of that day rather than an independent statement about eyes. It also places the stare inside the temporal frame before the subject appears, so the day surrounds the final image in grammar and word order.

topics.headline: pronoun loop to the day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final eye-staring clause held to the day it describes.
topics.reason: The suffix refers back to the day noun and is required for the relative description to cohere.

topics.headline: stare contained in the day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the staring is framed as occurring inside that bounded day, not as a timeless condition.
topics.reason: The preposition and suffix locate the event within the temporal endpoint.

topics.headline: frame heard before subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the day-reference before the eyes are named, so the temporal frame encloses the subject's arrival.
topics.reason: The phrase stands between verb and subject and compactly packages the temporal preposition with its pronoun.

words.gloss_range: definite broken plural subject: the eyes or sight-faculties that stare at the ayah's close
words.root_gloss_range: eyesight, sight, perception, discernment, insight, making-see, and divine seeing fields; locally the concrete plural sight-faculties are selected
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ}} ({{tr:al-abṣāru}}) is the delayed subject and final landing of the ayah. The definite plural makes the closure collective: sight-faculties, not one glance, are locked open. The broader sight and insight field is narrowed to this concrete plural, but it still contrasts with the opening denial of divine heedlessness: God is not inattentive, while created perception is forced into witness. The rare pairing with the staring verb, echoed at 21:97, makes the final word a specialized apocalyptic perception image, and its long ā leaves the ayah acoustically open on the very word for eyes. That frozen sight also opens the bodily posture scene continued in 14:43.

topics.headline: collective subject lands last
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah land on collective sight as its final noun.
topics.reason: The nominative broken plural subject follows verb and frame, becoming the closing word.

topics.headline: sight and insight narrowed to seized faculties
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that bodily eyes carry perception and insight pressure, while the local scene fixes them as seized sight-faculties.
topics.reason: The broader root field survives as pressure, but the local noun is the concrete plural subject of the staring verb.

topics.headline: divine awareness versus frozen sight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the verse's frame: divine non-heedlessness opens it, created sight frozen open closes it.
topics.reason: The opening predicate and final subject create a local awareness contrast across the ayah.

topics.headline: rare eye-staring pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the final noun as part of the rare eye-staring formula also supplied at 21:97.
topics.reason: The supplied data makes the sight root the defining partner of the rare staring root.

topics.headline: sensory closure with forward pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees abstract reckoning compressed into a bodily closure that opens the posture scene in 14:43.
topics.reason: The final noun carries closure weight and leads into the bodily description in 14:43.

topics.headline: open final sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the final sight word remain acoustically open as it names eyes held open.
topics.reason: The sound observation is local to the closing word and supports the image without changing the parse.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The prohibition in "do not suppose," the negated inattentiveness, and the exclusive "He only delays them."
baseline_models.mechanism: The two live branches of ح س ب make the supposition behave like a faulty account: visible non-intervention is entered as lack of attention, while the verse recodes the interval as deliberate scheduling.

activation_trace.role: Supposition supplies the rejected inference drawn from what appears to be happening.
Counting and accounting make that inference legible as a temporal miscalculation.
Inattention would leave deeds outside vigilance, precisely the state the verse negates.
Deferral to a later time replaces neglect as the cause of the visible interval.

changed_reading.before: The verse generally reassures that God knows about wrongdoing.
changed_reading.after: The verse diagnoses a specific bad inference: delayed response is being miscalculated as absent attention, although the delay itself is intentional.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction "what the wrongdoers do" joins an agent label to ongoing intentional action.
baseline_models.mechanism: Wrongdoing is not merely an identity; it is repeatedly produced through purposeful acts that displace what belongs in its proper setting or withhold a due right. Divine attention attaches to the doing.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful action supplies the operational character of the wrongdoing.
Withholding a right gives the agents' work a concrete social and legal mechanism.
Misplacing something in time or place adds a material ordering failure to the injustice.
Leaving something unrecorded supplies the evidentiary possibility explicitly denied of God.

changed_reading.before: The wrongdoers are a fixed condemned group.
changed_reading.after: They are identified by an accumulating practice of intentional displacement and withheld rights, none of which is left outside notice or record.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The endpoint is a day in which the eyes تشخص.
baseline_models.mechanism: The day is defined through involuntary ocular posture: sight rises and remains open under anxiety. Judgment first appears as loss of control over where and how one can look.

activation_trace.role: A severe event, rather than an ordinary date, supplies the character of the appointed day.
Raised, opened, unblinking sight supplies the body's fixed response.
An alarming event that makes one start upward supplies the affective cause of fixation.
The physical faculty of sight locates the consequence in the perceiving body.

changed_reading.before: The day will contain a frightening sight.
changed_reading.after: The day seizes the faculty of looking itself: eyes are forced upward and held open, making judgment an embodied loss of visual agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier divine delay is joined to forgiveness and an appointed term; after the focus, the wrongdoers ask for delay to a near term so that they can answer and follow. The same temporal operation reverses from an available response-window into an unavailable last request.

activation_trace.role: The focus's later scheduling is the hinge between the two contextual uses of delay.
Protective covering of fault makes the earlier appointed delay a possible interval of forgiveness.
Delay to a later time supplies the first, divinely offered interval.
A fixed temporal limit prevents that interval from meaning indefinite tolerance.
The wrongdoers' plea repeats delay after the scheduled day has arrived.
Temporal nearness makes the requested extension minimal but still too late.
Answering speech names the response they promise only after the first interval closes.
Following supplies the practical compliance deferred until it can no longer alter the outcome.

structural_cues: 14:10 offers delay to an appointed term; 14:42 names deliberate delay; 14:44 voices a failed request for another delay.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the mirrored delay clauses, forgiveness, fixed term, and promised response; I infer that the first delay functions as a bounded opportunity whose refusal produces the second plea. A live alternative is that 14:10 concerns only lifespan, without emphasizing opportunity.

changed_reading.before: God postpones punishment until a terrifying day.
changed_reading.after: The postponement is also a bounded response-window: its recipients mistake available time for neglect and ask for that same time only after it has closed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly separates intentional production, acquired result, coercive power, disclosed consequence, and matching recompense. Delay preserves rather than blurs the attribution between what wrongdoers do and what returns to each self.

activation_trace.role: The focus names purposeful work as the object of uninterrupted attention.
Intentional works become the material whose apparent substance is tested.
Acquisition ties the dissipating works back to what their agents sought and gained.
The denial of coercive power blocks transfer of responsibility to the caller.
Disclosed divine action supplies the consequence-side of the causal ledger.
Matching an act with its return makes the endpoint responsive rather than arbitrary.
What each self acquired supplies the individualized basis of recompense.

structural_cues: Works disperse in 14:18, coercive authority is denied in 14:22, prior outcomes are made clear in 14:45, and recompense matches acquisition in 14:51.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated action, acquisition, power, disclosure, and recompense terms; I infer an evidentiary chain in which delay allows agency to remain attributable. An alternative is a looser moral sequence without a procedural function for delay.

changed_reading.before: God observes the wrongdoers' actions before later punishment.
changed_reading.after: The observed actions remain attached to their agents through a causal ledger: no coercive power excuses them, and each acquisition receives its corresponding return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Failed human enumeration of gifts leads into the day when account stands, the focus's prohibition against faulty supposition, and the final swift account. Apparent slowness belongs to the waiting interval, not to reckoning once due.

activation_trace.role: The accounting branch turns the forbidden supposition into a faulty calculation about time and attention.
Counting supplies the attempted human inventory of divine gifts.
Exhaustive enumeration fails, exposing the limits of the human ledger.
The standing account immediately before the focus supplies its explicit judicial horizon.
Recompense pairs the account with an exact responsive outcome.
Speed, the opposite of slowness, resolves the apparent contradiction between delay and account.
Final accounting closes the lexical ring opened by human counting and the focus's rejected reckoning.

structural_cues: 14:34, 14:41, 14:42, and 14:51 form an ordered count-account sequence around the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated counting roots and their order; I infer that uncounted present generosity plus deferred settlement generates the wrongdoers' accounting error. A live alternative is simple lexical recurrence without a single ledger mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The imperative only forbids thinking that God is unaware.
changed_reading.after: It also corrects temporal bookkeeping: humans cannot inventory present gifts, yet infer from delayed settlement that no account is running, even though the account is swift when it arrives.

context_deltas.mechanism: Before the focus, hidden and public material are equally known; afterward prior outcomes become clear, all persons emerge exposed, and covering falls over faces. Delay changes the wrongdoers' exposure, not God's access to information.

activation_trace.role: Negated inattention anchors the contrast between present divine access and future human exposure.
Physical sight anchors the exposure sequence in the focus's perceiving bodies.
Concealment supplies the category that is explicitly unavailable against divine knowledge.
Public manifestation is paired with hidden material as equally accessible.
Prior outcomes becoming manifest supplies a historical mode of disclosure.
Emergence into exposure supplies the public endpoint of the delayed interval.
A covering that overtakes the surface reverses any expectation that concealment protects.
The face as forward surface localizes the final covering on the exposed person.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from hidden/public knowledge in 14:38 to staring eyes, historical clarification, open emergence, and finally covered faces.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the concealment, manifestation, exposure, and covering sequence; I infer an asymmetry in which God already sees while wrongdoers are progressively made visible and unable to manage sight. The alternative is that these are separate epistemic and punitive images.

changed_reading.before: God is not unaware now and will make wrongdoers see later.
changed_reading.after: Nothing becomes newly visible to God; the scheduled change is on the wrongdoers' side, where concealment fails, bodies emerge, and sight can no longer regulate exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah distributes the focus's ocular verb across rushing approach, elevated heads, failed return of the blink, and emptied hearts. The gaze is one component of a coordinated collapse of posture, attention, and inward capacity.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies raised, fixed sight as the bodily anchor expanded by the next ayah.
Rushing forward gives the fixed gaze an involuntary locomotor setting.
Unlowered elevation fixes the head orientation that supports the upward stare.
The blink and glance fail to return, converting staring into sustained loss of visual control.
A heart weakened as though absent gives the outward fixation an inward collapse.
Air and vacancy supply the emptied condition of the inward center.

structural_cues: 14:43 is a syntactic continuation of the day-clause in 14:42 and anatomically expands its eyes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies movement, head elevation, nonreturning glance, and inward vacancy; I infer one coordinated sensorimotor mechanism rather than a list of symptoms. A live alternative is that the images accumulate affectively without a single physiological chain.

changed_reading.before: The eyes stare upward from fear.
changed_reading.after: The entire person is captured: forward motion continues, the head cannot lower, the blink cannot return, and the inward center has no capacity left to redirect the gaze.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's "do not suppose God inattentive" is echoed five ayat later by "do not suppose God failing His promise." The paired prohibitions close both escape routes from delayed fulfillment: neither missing knowledge nor a missed commitment explains the wait.

activation_trace.role: The first supposition wrongly converts delay into absent awareness.
Inattention names the epistemic failure denied in the first prohibition.
The repeated supposition formally pairs the later correction with the focus.
A promise missing its appointed time supplies the second false explanation of delay.
A promise bounded by time or place makes fulfillment compatible with waiting.
Punitive response after rejection supplies the promised action toward which delay moves.

structural_cues: The near-verbatim prohibitions at 14:42 and 14:47 frame the intervening panic, plea, inherited ruins, and plotting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated ح س ب construction and the failure-of-promise branch; I infer a deliberate two-part correction of the observer's model of divine delay. The alternative is emphatic repetition without a knowledge-versus-promise distinction.

changed_reading.before: The focus denies only that God has overlooked wrongdoing.
changed_reading.after: Together with 14:47 it denies both ignorance and nonfulfillment: God knows the deeds, retains the commitment, and schedules rather than abandons its execution.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the form-distant branch of غ ف ل for an unmarked road or creature, so it is surprising; it remains anchored in the focus's negated root and is activated by visible signs, clarification, warning, and reminder across the surah. Render only as an exploratory evidentiary metaphor, not as the primary lexical sense of غافلا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The negation of غافلا can activate not only inattentiveness but the image of something left without a distinguishing mark.

activation_trace.role: An unmarked route or creature supplies the exploratory image of deeds or time left without evidentiary marks.
Visible signs supply marks that make the historical interval readable.
Meaning disclosed through speech or sign supplies explicit evidentiary clarification.
Warning that awakens caution makes the delayed interval communicative rather than blank.
Reminder supplies a recurring marker against forgetful reading of the delay.

changed_reading.before: God is not mentally inattentive to the wrongdoers.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, neither their deeds nor the waiting interval are left trackless: signs, examples, warning, and reminder keep marking what apparent delay might make seem blank.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The reading is surprising because it connects the same فؤاد and ه و ي pair across different scenes and senses; it remains anchored through the focus's eyes and the immediate continuation's hearts. Qualify it as a lexical-structural reversal, not as proof that the two scenes are direct opposites in every respect.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's immobilized eyes stand between a prior scene of hearts inclining and a following scene of hearts as air.

activation_trace.role: Inner discernment keeps the focus's physical eyes connected to an inward faculty.
The heart as an inwardly kindled center supplies the subject of directed attraction.
Inclination of desire gives those hearts an object and direction.
A heart weakened as if absent reverses the earlier inwardly active center.
Air and vacancy reverse directed inclination into an objectless interior.

changed_reading.before: Staring eyes simply register external terror.
changed_reading.after: The gaze may mark a reversal in orientation: where living hearts could incline toward an object, the judged body has outward fixation paired with an inward center emptied of direction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This spatializes temporal delay through the departure branch of ش خ ص and the contextual removal of supposedly stable structures, making it branch-distant but still anchored in يؤخرهم and تشخص. Present it as a secondary spatial model; it should not replace the direct reading of fixed eyes and delayed judgment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins postponement with a root that can denote departure from a place, while ظلم can image putting something outside its proper time or place.

activation_trace.role: Temporal deferral supplies a period in which displacement is held back.
Departure from a place supplies the exploratory spatial edge of the focus's ocular verb.
Wrong placement in time or space links injustice to disordered location.
Claimed continuance supplies the wrongdoers' confidence that their condition will not pass.
Removal from place or state reverses the preceding claim of continuance.
A solid elevated mass supplies the strongest apparent object of stable emplacement.
One thing standing in place of another supplies total replacement at the endpoint.
The lower ground itself becomes the object replaced, scaling displacement beyond individual removal.
Forced emergence completes the move from deferred emplacement to exposed relocation.

changed_reading.before: The wrongdoers remain temporarily where they are and are punished later.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, delay holds back a comprehensive displacement: presumed permanence, mountain-like stability, the ground itself, and finally the wrongdoers' own emplacement are all overturned.

strongest_changes: The delay becomes a bounded response-window whose recipients request a second time only after the first closes.
The count-account sequence recasts apparent impunity as faulty temporal bookkeeping and distinguishes delayed settlement from swift reckoning.
The staring eyes expand into a full-body capture of motion, head posture, blinking, and inward capacity.
The paired prohibitions in 14:42 and 14:47 deny both missing knowledge and failed promise as explanations of delay.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context turned one apparent gap between deed and consequence into several coexisting mechanisms: offered respite, preserved agency, active accounting, asymmetric exposure, bodily seizure, and promise fulfillment. The repeated roots around the focus also supported contained readings of marked time, reversed heart-orientation, and deferred displacement.
remaining_uncertainties: The ledger reading may be a rhetorical network rather than a procedural account of why delay occurs.
The heart-orientation reversal depends on treating the repeated فؤاد and ه و ي pair as deliberate cross-scene activation.
The unmarked-interval and deferred-displacement readings rely on form-distant branches and should remain exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Delay must not be miscounted as omission.** `ح س ب` `B002` (supposition), `غ ف ل` `B002` (leaving unwritten/unmarked), `ع م ل` `B001` (intentional work), and `ء خ ر` `B002` (deferral) oppose apparent temporal absence to preserved account. The prior prayer for the day reckoning rises and later swift account supply the correction. I infer deferred consequence can look like an unrecorded act only from within short time. The ayah reads as an epistemic warning about mistaking schedule for neglect.

2. **Raised vision is forced exposure without usable sight.** `ش خ ص` `B004` is a raised fixed gaze and `B005` being jolted up by alarm; `ب ص ر` `B001` is eye-seeing and `B002` inner sight. The next ayah denies returning glances and empties hearts. I infer ocular fixation blocks reflective seeing: the eyes are maximally open but cannot process or redirect. The image reads as perception seized by its object.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The swift account of 14:51 finally resolves the apparent delay: deferred timing never implied slow access, incomplete records, or difficult calculation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Human supposition is corrected by divine reckoning.** `ح س ب B002` supplies reckoning as supposition, while the immediately preceding `ٱلْحِسَاب` activated `ح س ب B001` counting and account. The same root moves from the observer's false inference to the coming audit. I infer that the delay is misread because human estimation substitutes for the account not yet stood up. `لَا تَحْسَبَنَّ` reads as a warning against confusing deferred visibility with absent reckoning.
2. **Heedlessness would mean leaving deeds unmarked, which the context denies.** `غ ف ل B001` supplies falling outside attention, and `غ ف ل B002` knowingly leaving something unwritten or unmarked. 14:38 said no knowable thing is hidden, 14:41 named the account, 14:45 says examples were made clear, and 14:46 places schemes `عِندَ ٱللَّه`. The packet supplies knowledge, record-like accounting, and presence; I infer that no deed is omitted from the marked field. `غَافِلًا` is thus denied in an administrative as well as attentional sense.
3. **Postponement accumulates toward perceptual seizure.** `ء خ ر B002` supplies deferring to a later time, `ش خ ص B004` a raised fixed gaze, and `ب ص ر B001` sight. The verse explicitly supplies delay → day → gaze, and 14:43 expands the frozen sensorimotor posture. I infer that postponement does not dissipate consequence but concentrates it at a fixed perceptual event. The day is an appointed release of what delay held back.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 14:43 expanded the fixed gaze into a complete failed feedback loop, while 14:46 placed the schemes `عِندَ ٱللَّه` and 14:47 denied promise-failure. Together they corrected postponement into retained, fully present accounting rather than omission.

baseline.text: Zalimlerin yaptıklarından Allah'ı sakın habersiz sanma. O, onları ancak gözlerin donup kalacağı bir güne erteliyor.

findings.text: Gecikmeyi ihmale yormak, henüz görünmeyen hesabın yerine kısa vadeli insan tahminini koymaktır.
Habersizlik, yapılanların dikkat alanından çıkması yanında kayda geçirilmeden bırakılması demek olurdu; bağlam özellikle bu ihtimali reddeder.
Erteleme sonucu dağıtmaz; onu gözlerin açık olduğu hâlde düşünme ve yön değiştirme gücünü kaybettiği tek bir algısal ana biriktirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eylem çekirdeğini türemiş eylem ve varlık adlarından ayırır; türemiş biçimlerin kapsamı yalın eylemin tamamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, tapınmayı anlamın temeli sayar; kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılma işlemini bu temelden türetir. Tapınma konusu sayılan yontular ve güneş örneği, varlık anlamının belirli uygulamalarıdır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أله وتأله بمعنى عبد وتنسك، والتأليه بمعنى التعبيد، والإله والآلهة والإلاهة لما جعل معبودا.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه أله بمعنى تحير، ولا ألهت على فلان بمعنى اشتد جزعي عليه، ولا أسماء المواضع أو الحية أو الهلال إلا من جهة التسمية لا معنى العبادة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو التعبد، فالإله الله تعالى لأنه معبود، وتأله الرجل إذا تعبد، والإلاهة الشمس سميت بذلك لأن قوما كانوا يعبدونها (maqayis)؛ التأله التعبد (ayn)؛ أله بالفتح إلاهة أي عبد عبادة، مألوه أي معبود، الآلهة الأصنام، التأليه التعبيد، التأله التنسك والتعبد (sihah)؛ لا يكون إلاها حتى يكون معبودا، معبوداتهم من الأصنام والأوثان آلهة، الإلاهة الشمس، وإلاهتك وعبادتك (tahdhib)؛ إله اسما لكل معبود، أله فلان يأله الآلهة عبد، فالإله على هذا هو المعبود (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini, genel tapınılan-varlık adından türetiliş açıklamasını ve bu özel adla kurulan seslenme ile ant biçimlerini birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak dal yalnızca seslenme ve ant kalıpları değildir; özel adın yalın kullanımı da çekirdekte tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, özel ad ile bu ada bağlı seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimleriyle sınırlıdır; herhangi bir tapınılan varlığı gösteren genel ad anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın özel ad, doğrudan seslenme biçimleri ve ant ya da şaşma kalıpları ayrı tutulur; kalıplara özgü işlevler özel adın her kullanımına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini ve bu adla kurulan seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimlerini kapsar. Bu biçimler doğrudan seslenme, adın ant değeriyle kullanılması veya ses ve parçaların düşürülmesiyle kısaltılma yollarını gösterir.

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
Özel adın, tapınılan varlığı bildiren genel addan ses düşmesi ve belirleyici unsur eklenmesiyle oluştuğu açıklanır.
Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.
Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bağlam, dikkatin dışında kalan şeyi öne çıkarıyor ve sonradan bırakılmış olmayı belirtmiyorsa uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Şeyin dikkat alanının dışında kalmasını doğal biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Dalgınlığın bir şeyi bırakmaya yol açtığı sonucu açıkça söylemez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir işte, okumada veya sıralamada bir unsurun istemeden bırakıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dalgınlık nedeniyle bir unsurun istemeden bırakılması anlamını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dikkatin zayıflığı yüzünden bir şeyin o anda gözden kaçması belirleyicidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Önceden bilinen bir şeyin bellekten çıkması ve hatırlanamaz olması belirleyicidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisinde de kişi bir şeyi zihninde hazır tutamaz ve buna bağlı bir eksiklik yaşar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol anlık dikkat ve uyanıklık eksikliğine dayanır; komşu ise daha önce bilinen şeyin bellekten uzaklaşmasına dayanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Genel olarak yetersiz dikkat ve kendini kollama yüzünden gözden kaçırma vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir uğraş, korku veya üzüntü gibi belirli bir etken dikkati başka yöne çeker.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki anlamda da kişinin dikkati nesnede kalmaz ve nesne farkındalığın dışında kalabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol belirli bir dış neden gerektirmeyen dikkat eksikliğini anlatır; komşu, dikkati uzaklaştıran bir etkeni öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Uyanıklığın azalmasıyla bir şeyin fark edilmemesi söz konusudur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bakışı yineleyerek sürdürme, uyanık kalma ve dikkatle gözetme söz konusudur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da dikkatin bir nesne üzerinde tutulup tutulmaması ekseninde karşılaştırılabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol dikkat bağının çözülmesini, komşu ise aynı bağın bilinçli biçimde sürdürülmesini anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bildirilen komşuların tümü değerlendirildi; en yakın karışma alanlarını gösteren unutma, dikkatin dağılması ve uyanık gözetme karşılaştırmaları seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الغفلة والغفول عن الشيء، وتركه سهوا لقلة التحفظ والتيقظ.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الترك المتعمد مع الذكر، ولا جعل الشيء بلا علامة، ولا اهتبال غفلة غيره.
branches.source_phrase_ar: غفلت عن الشيء غفلة وغفولا إذا تركته ساهيا (maqayis)؛ غفل يغفل غفلفة وغفولا (ayn)؛ غفل عن الشيء يغفل غفلة وغفولا (sihah)؛ الغفلة سهو يعتري الإنسان من قلة التحفظ والتيقظ (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kişi farkındayken bir şeyi bırakma çekirdeğini ve buna bağlı iki özel kullanımı destekler: yazıyı ayırt edici işaretlerden yoksun bırakma ile iç dünyayı inançtan yoksun bırakma. Bunlar tek bir sınırsız yalın anlam gibi birleştirilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Genel çekirdek bilerek bırakmadır; yazı ve iç dünya okumaları kendi söz çevreleriyle sınırlı özel gerçekleşmelerdir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın eylem ile yazıya ve iç dünyaya bağlı özel kullanımlar ayrı tutulmuş, özel okumalar bütün kola yayılmamıştır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi unutmadan ve onun farkındayken bilerek bırakmak ya da eksik bırakmaktır. Yazıda ayırt edici işaretleri koymama ve iç dünyayı inançtan yoksun bırakma, bu çekirdeğin belirli söz çevrelerine bağlı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Kişi bıraktığı şeyi hatırlamakta ve bilmekte olduğu halde onu bilerek dışarıda tutar.
Yazı bağlamında bırakma, harfleri ayıran noktaları veya benzeri ayırt edici işaretleri koymamaktır.
İç dünya bağlamındaki bir yorum, kişinin inanç yerleşmemiş halde bırakılmasını anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bilerek bırakma konusunda birleşir; toplu ifade ayrıca yazının işaretsiz bırakılması ile iç dünyanın inançtan yoksun bırakılması yorumlarını taşır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kişinin şeyi unutmadığı halde onu dışarıda tutması veya tamamlamaması biçimindeki ortak çekirdeği karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Farkında olmayı, bilerek bırakmayı ve ortaya çıkan eksikliği korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yazının harfleri ayıran noktalar veya benzeri işaretler eklenmeden bırakıldığı özel bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yazının ayırt edici işaretler eklenmeden bilerek bırakılmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İç dünyanın inanç yerleşmemiş halde bırakıldığı kaynak yorumunu açıklamak için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İç dünyada inancın yerleşmemiş bırakılması yorumunu açıkça korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: içini inançtan yoksun bırakmak ya da gerçekleri fark edemez kılmak

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bırakan kişi şeyi hatırlamakta ve bilmekte olduğu halde onu dışarıda tutar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bırakma isteyerek, zorla veya yalnızca hiçbir işlem yapmadan gerçekleşebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki anlam da bir şeyi almama, yapmama veya bulunduğu halde bırakma sonucunu içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol farkındalık sürerken yapılan bilinçli eksik bırakmayı gerektirir; komşu, nedeni ve kişinin zihinsel durumunu sınırlamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir unsur baştan eklenmez veya şey eksik halde bırakılır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki işlem de sonunda bir işaretin ya da yazılı unsurun görünmemesine yol açabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolda belirleyici işlem koymamak ve eksik bırakmaktır; komşuda var olan izi gidermek belirleyicidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yazıdaki ayırt edici unsurun konmadan bırakılması söz konusudur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kalemle çizgi, yazı veya görünür bir iz oluşturulması söz konusudur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki anlam da yazı yüzeyindeki görünür çizgi ve ayırt edici işaretlerle ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol işareti koymama yönündedir; komşu ise çizgi veya yazı oluşturarak işaret bırakma yönündedir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bildirilen komşuların tümü değerlendirildi; bırakma çekirdeğini, sonradan silmeyi ve yazıyla işaret koymayı ayıran üç karşılaştırma yayımlandı.
branches.branch_image_ar: ترك مع الذكر أو ترك بلا كتابة وعلامة
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أغفلت الشيء إذا تركته وأنت ذاكر، وإغفال الكتاب بتركه غير معجم، وتفسير أغفلنا قلبه بتركه غير مكتوب فيه الإيمان.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه السهو المحض، ولا تفسير أغفلنا بمعنى جعله غافلا عن الحقائق.
branches.source_phrase_ar: وأغفلته إذا تركته على ذكر منك له (maqayis)؛ وأغفلت الشيء تركته غفلا وأنت له ذاكر (ayn)؛ وأغفلت الشيء إذا تركته على ذكر منك (sihah)؛ إغفال الكتاب تركه غير معجم، تركناه غير مكتوب فيه الإيمان (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi öznenin kendi dalgınlığını değil, başka birini bir şeye karşı dikkatsiz veya fark edemez hale getirmesini anlatır. Verilen kol bu ettirgen katılımcı değişimini doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu anlam, kişinin kendi kendine dalması veya farkında olduğu bir şeyi bilerek eksik bırakması değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca başkasını dikkatsiz ya da fark edemez kılan türemiş kullanımlara bağlanmıştır.

concept_map.definition: Bir başkasının dikkatini bir şeyden uzaklaştırarak onu o şeyi fark etmez veya gerçeklere karşı uyanık olmaz hale getirmektir.

facets.statement: Eylemi yapan kişi, başka birinin belirli bir şeyi fark etmemesine neden olur.
Etki, kişinin gerçekleri kavramaya karşı dikkatsiz ve kapalı hale getirilmesini de kapsayabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak ifadesi, bir başkasına yönelen ettirgen anlamda birleşir; sonuç, belirli bir şeyi veya gerçekleri fark edememe durumudur.

concept_gloss.text: birini bir şeye karşı dikkatsiz kılma
concept_gloss.applicability: Başka bir kişinin dikkatini nesneden uzaklaştırma ve onda fark etmeme durumu oluşturma çekirdeğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Ettirgen katılımcı yapısını, dikkat kaybını ve yöneldiği şeyi korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalgınlığın kimi zaman bilerek seçildiğini ve kişinin bilerek fark etmez tutum takındığını destekler. Ancak genel anlamda her türlü yüz çevirme kaynak çekirdeği değildir; tanım bu nedenle bilerek görmezden gelmeyle sınırlandırılmıştır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kol, genel ilgisizlikten veya yön değiştirmeden çok, farkında olunan şeyi bilerek fark etmez görünme tutumudur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik yalın kapsam korunmuş, herhangi bir özel söz öbeğinin anlamı tanıma taşınmamıştır.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin aslında farkında olduğu bir şeyi bilerek fark etmiyormuş gibi davranması ve ona dikkatini yöneltmemesidir.

facets.statement: Dikkatsizlik kendiliğinden doğmaz; kişi farkındalığını bilerek geri planda tutar.
Dışarıdan görülen sonuç, farkında olunan şeyi görmezden gelme ve ona yönelmemedir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, istemsiz dalgınlıktan farklı olarak dikkatsiz görünme tutumunun bilerek benimsenebileceğini birlikte destekler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Farkındalık sürerken kişinin onu belli etmemesi ve dikkatini bilerek geri çekmesi anlamını karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Bilerek yapmayı, farkındalığın sürmesini ve dışa vuran ilgisizliği korur.

error_profile.preserves: Gerçek farkındalık ile dışarıya gösterilen fark etmeme arasındaki ayrımı korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki anlamda da kişi aslında erişebileceği bir şeyi bilerek fark etmiyormuş gibi davranır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol genel bir bilinçli dikkatsizlik tutumudur; komşu görmeme benzetmesini ve bazı kullanımlarda doğru davranmaktan sapmayı daha belirgin taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Farkındalık sürer, fakat kişi fark etmemiş gibi davranmayı seçer.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki anlam da bir şeye dikkat veya ilgi göstermemeyle sonuçlanabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolda iç farkındalık ile dış tutum arasındaki karşıtlık belirleyicidir; komşuda yönelimin fiilen başka tarafa çevrilmesi yeterlidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kişi fark ettiği şeyi bilerek fark etmez görünür.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki tutum da dışarıdan ilgi göstermeme biçiminde görünebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol bilerek kurulmuş bir fark etmeme görünüşüdür; komşu ise şeyin önemsenmemesine dayanır ve gizli farkındalık gerektirmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bildirilen komşuların tümü değerlendirildi; bilinçli görmezden gelmeyi yüz çevirme ve aldırmamadan ayıran en yararlı üç ilişki seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه التغافل بمعنى التعمد، وما يقترب من ترك الشيء عن عمد ضمن أصل الغفلة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه ختل غيرك عن غفلة ولا اهتبال غفلته.
branches.source_phrase_ar: ربما كان عن عمد (maqayis)؛ التغافل التعمد (ayn)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, başka birinin dalgınlığını uygun an sayıp bundan yararlanarak onu kandırmayı anlatır. Kol çerçevesi hem iki ayrı katılımcıyı hem de kandırmanın dalgınlığa bağlı koşulunu korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu anlam kişinin kendi dalgınlığı veya koşulsuz bir kandırma değil, karşı tarafın dikkatsizliğinden yararlanan kandırmadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca karşı tarafın dalgınlığından yararlanmayı bildiren türemiş kullanımlarla sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir başkasının dalgın olduğu anı kollayıp dikkat boşluğundan yararlanarak onu kandırmak veya zarara açık hale getirmektir.

facets.statement: Eylemi yapan kişi, karşı tarafın dalgınlığını fark eder ve bunu uygun bir fırsat olarak kullanır.
Fırsattan yararlanmanın amacı karşı tarafı kandırmak veya onun aleyhine bir sonuç elde etmektir.

error_profile.preserves: Dikkat açığını kollamayı, fırsattan yararlanmayı ve aldatmayı korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Karşı tarafın dalgınlığı doğrudan yakalanıp fırsat olarak kullanılır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki anlam da karşı tarafın korunmasız yanından yararlanarak onu istemediği bir sonuca götürür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol anlık dikkatsizlik fırsatına dayanır; komşu ise yakınlık ve yumuşaklıkla sürdürülen aşamalı bir kandırma yöntemidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Eylem, karşı tarafın dalgınlığını yakalama koşuluna bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kötülük tasarlama, süre tanıma ve kişiyi adım adım sonuca sürükleme gibi daha geniş yolları kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki anlamda da kişi karşı tarafın aleyhine planlı bir üstünlük elde edebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol tek bir dikkat boşluğundan yararlanmayı anlatır; komşu daha geniş ve uzun süreli bir kötülük düzenini anlatabilir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bildirilen komşuların tümü değerlendirildi; dikkat boşluğu koşulunu genel hileden, yumuşak kandırmadan ve geniş düzen kurmadan ayıran ilişkiler seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه التغفل، أي الختل عن غفلة أو اهتبال غفلة الغير.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه السهو الواقع من الشخص نفسه ولا مجرد التعمد دون ختل.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ortak çekirdeği, yerin, yolun veya hayvanın tanıtıcı bir işaret taşımamasıdır. Issızlık, bayındırlık izi bulunmaması, yağmur görmeme ve ölü arazi olma kayıtları yalnızca araziye bağlı kaynak çeşitleridir; ortak çekirdekle özdeşleştirilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: İşaretsizlik çekirdektir; ıssızlık, işlenmemişlik ve yağmursuzluk yalnızca arazi kullanımlarına bağlı çeşitlerdir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ortak nitelik ile arazi, yol ve hayvan söz öbeklerine bağlı gerçekleşmeler ayrı yüzler halinde korunmuştur.

concept_map.definition: Bir yerin, yolun veya hayvanın onu tanıtacak görünür bir işaret, yön gösterici ya da damga taşımamasıdır. Arazi için bu nitelik ıssızlık, bayındırlık izi bulunmaması, ölü toprak olma veya yağmur görmeme biçimlerinde de anlatılmıştır.

facets.statement: Söz konusu varlıkta onu başkalarından ayıracak ya da tanımayı sağlayacak görünür bir belirti bulunmaz.
Arazi ve yol kullanımında yön göstermeye yarayan belirti, sınır taşı veya insan yapısı iz yoktur.
Hayvan kullanımında sahipliği veya kimliği gösteren damga bulunmaz.
Araziye bağlı çeşitlerde yer ıssız, işlenmemiş, ölü toprak veya yağmur görmemiş olarak nitelenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar tanıtıcı işaretin bulunmaması çekirdeğinde birleşir; arazi için ıssızlık, işlenmemişlik, yağmursuzluk ve ölü toprak olma gibi ek betimler aktarılır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الأرض الغفل والسبسب والطريق الذي لا علامة فيه، والدابة أو الناقة التي لا سمة عليها، والموات، وما قيل في الأرض التي لا مطر أو لا عمارة فيها.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الإنسان الغفل لقلة التجربة أو الفطنة إلا من جهة التشبيه العام بعدم العلامة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: لكل ما لا معلم له غفل، أرض غفل لا علم بها، وناقة غفل لا سمة عليها (maqayis)؛ الغفل سبسب متيه بعيد لا علامة فيها، وطريق غفل لا علامة فيه، ودابة غفل لا سمة عليها (ayn)؛ الأغفال الموات، أرض غفل لا علم بها ولا أثر عمارة، أرض غفل لم تمطر، ودابة غفل لا سمة عليها (sihah)؛ أرض غفل لا منار بها (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insan için deneyimle sınanmamış olmayı ve kavrayış eksikliğini destekler; ayrıca kişinin değeri veya soyu bilinmiyor olabilir. Bu son kayıt deneyimsizlikle aynı özellik değildir ve ayrı bir kaynak çeşidi olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Deneyimsizlik ve kavrayış eksikliği ana kişi nitelikleridir; değerin veya soyun bilinmemesi ayrı bir kullanım çeşididir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kişiye bağlı söz öbeği ile tek sözcüklü kavrayışsız kişi adı ayrılmış, farklı kişi nitelikleri birbirine karıştırılmamıştır.

concept_map.definition: Hayatın ve işlerin sınamasından geçmemiş, bu yüzden deneyimsiz olan ya da yeterli kavrayış göstermeyen kişidir. Bazı kullanımlarda kişinin değeri veya soyu bilinmez.

Kişide durumları sezme, ayırt etme ve uygun biçimde kavrama gücü yetersizdir.
Bir kişi için sahip olduğu değer veya bağlı olduğu soyun bilinmediği de anlatılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar deneyimle sınanmamış kişi anlamında birleşir; toplu ifade ayrıca kavrayış eksikliği ile kişinin değeri veya soyunun bilinmemesi kayıtlarını taşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bağlı tutulduğu için etkisiz sayılan, ne iyilik yapması umulan ne de kötülüğünden korkulan kişiyi tanımlar; ayrıca bu duruma girmeyi bildiren eylem ve çoğul biçim kaydı verir. Kol bu özel kişi tipini doğru korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu kolu, canlı bir yapanın bilerek ortaya koyduğu iş veya eylem olarak kurar. İyi ve kötü davranış örnekleri bu çekirdeğin ahlaki alanlara da uygulanabildiğini gösterir; ücret, görev, karşılıklı işlem veya özel adlar bu kola ait değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hem yalın iş anlamı hem de belirli kalıplı kullanımlar vardır; tanım yalın çekirdeği verir, kalıplı örnekleri bu çekirdeğe bağlı tutar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik profil kalıplı kullanım verir; tanım yalnız yaya yolcu topluluğu ifadesi için geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Yolculukta binek kullanmadan yürüyen yolcuları adlandıran kalıplı topluluk ifadesidir. El işçileri ya da yolun kendisi anlamına gelmez.

facets.statement: Yolculuk eden kişilerin yaya gitmesi ana anlamdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, anlamı yolculuk sırasında yürüyerek giden kişiler için kalıplı bir adlandırma olarak sınırlar.

source_details.summary: Tek kaynaklı tanıklık, bu topluluk adını binek kullanmadan yürüyen yolcularla sınırlar.

root_profile.summary: Bu kök ailesi, bilinçli iş yapma çekirdeğinden çalıştırma, görevlendirme, ücret, karşılıklı işlem, işçi topluluğu, zahmet, işe yatkınlık, nesne parçası, beden parçası, işlek yol ve yaya yolcular gibi ayrı kollara açılır. Kolların çoğu iş alanıyla ilişkili olsa da bazıları yalnız kalıplı adlandırmalar veya nesne adları olarak korunmalıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kolu isigin yoklugu ve bunun bilgisizlik, ortak kosma, yoldan cikma gibi karanlik benzetmelerine genislemesi olarak veriyor. Bu, gecici cercevedeki fiziksel karanlik ve anlam genislemesini karsilar; adil olmayan davranis, erken sut kullanimi ve dis pariltisi disarida kalir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kapsam fiziksel isik yoklugu ile ona bagli zihinsel ve inancsal benzetmelerdir; haksiz davranis degildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam mixed_non_bare oldugu icin ciplak karanlik adlari ile kullanim kaliplari ayrilir; baska kollarin kaliplari buraya tasinmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir yer, zaman ya da durum icin isigin bulunmamasi veya gorunusun kapanmasidir. Bu fiziksel karanlik, bilgisizlik, ortak kosma, yoldan cikma ve gucluk gibi durumlara benzetme yoluyla genisler.

facets.statement: Isigin gitmesi, yok olmasi veya gorunurun kapanmasi kolun cekirdegidir.
Bilgisizlik, ortak kosma ve yoldan cikma gibi soyut durumlar karanliga benzetilerek anlatilir.
Bir kisinin, toplulugun, yerin veya gecenin karanliga girmesi bu cekirdege bagli bir kullanimdir.
Ay icindeki belirli karanlik geceler ve gorusu ilk kapatan an, cekirdegin zamanla ilgili ornekleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu kolu isigin karsiti ve isigin yoklugu olarak birlestirir; cogul ve gece kullanimlarini, ayrica bilgisizlik ve inanc sapmasi icin benzetmeli genislemeyi ayni alan icinde verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kolu bir seyi kendi yerine koymama, dogru siniri asma, eksiltme ve kisinin kendisine ya da baskasina zarar veren yanlis davranisi olarak toplar. Gecici cerceve bu cekirdegi dogru yansitir; fiziksel karanlik, dis pariltisi ve hayvan adi bu koldan ayridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kapsam dogru yer, pay veya sinirin bozulmasidir; yalnizca isik yoklugu ya da somut ad degildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam mixed_non_bare oldugu icin genel haksiz yerlesim cekirdegi ile yol, kisi ve inancla ilgili kullanislari ayrilmis tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir seyi kendisine uygun yere, paya veya sinira koymamak; dogru olcuyu asmak ya da eksiltmektir. Kapsam, baskasina haksiz davranmayi, kisinin kendisine zarar vermesini, yoldan sapmayi ve inanc alanindaki agir yanlisi icerir.

facets.statement: Cekirdek, seyin kendisine uygun yer, pay veya sinirdan cikarilmasidir.
Dogru siniri asma, az ya da cok olabilen haksiz davranis olarak genisler.
Eksiltme, kismak ve yoldan ya da dogru amactan sapmak bu cekirdege bagli kullanimlardir.
Kisinin kendine zarar vermesi ve Tanri'ya ortak kosma gibi inanc yanlisi da ayni haksiz yerlesim alaninda verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar cekirdegi bir seyi uygun yerinden cikarma olarak ortaklastirir. Ayni claim, dogru siniri asma, eksiltme, kisinin kendisine zarar vermesi ve inanc alanindaki en agir yanlis gibi genislemeleri de birlikte verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, haksizliga ugrayan kisinin geri istedigi seyi, haksizliktan yakinmasini, birini haksizlikla nitelemesini ve kimi durumlarda haksizliga katlanmasini birlikte verir. Bu, gecici cercevedeki yakinma ve duzeltme istemi alanini karsilar; haksiz davranisin kendisi ana cekirdek degildir.

concept_map.definition: Haksizliga ugrayan kisinin geri istedigi sey, bu haksizligi dile getirmesi veya karsi tarafi haksiz diye nitelemesidir. Kol ayrica kendisine kaldirabileceginden fazla yuklenen kisinin buna katlanmasini da icerir.

facets.statement: Haksizliga ugrayan kisinin geri istedigi sey veya kendisine ait istem cekirdektir.
Haksizliktan yakinmak ve duzeltilmesini istemek bu cekirdege bagli eylemdir.
Birini haksiz diye nitelemek veya ona haksiz davrandigini bildirmek ayni tepki alanina girer.
Kisinin kaldirabileceginden fazlasi istenince buna katlanmasi genisletilmis bir kullanistir.

facets.statement: Cekirdek, bir somut islemde uygun zaman, yer veya kosulun bozulmasidir.
Sutun olgunlasmadan icilmesi veya icirilmesi zamansiz kullanim ornegidir.
Topragi uygunsuz yerde kazmak, havuzu uygun olmayan yerde yapmak veya vadi suyunun yeni yere ulasmasi yerle ilgili orneklerdir.
Hastalik yokken deveyi kesmek ve gebe disege yaklasan erkek esek canliyla ilgili uygunsuz kosul ornekleridir.
